name: AI Goal Planner
description: An in-game Chat in which the AI sets up and configures your other Blish HUD modules to reach a goal you describe.

account.details: Reads your account's Owned Content so the AI suggests only content you can access.

progression.details: Reads your mastery points and masteries to plan what you still need.

characters.details: Reads hero challenge progress for your current character.
